usage: pactkit schema [-h] [--all]
                      [{spec,board,context,lessons,testcase,config,--all}]

positional arguments:
  {spec,board,context,lessons,testcase,config,--all}
                        Document type to show schema for ('config' lists all
                        pactkit.yaml keys)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --all                 Show all schemas
